verdict.rationale: cubic documents automatic PR summaries that generate PR descriptions from code changes (docs-21, docs-57), configurable via cubic.yaml (docs-34) and enriched with Notion context (docs-61), and it reviews new PRs automatically (docs-1). A changelog entry describes grouped change descriptions that stay beside the diff as you scroll, which amounts to a walkthrough in its PR UI (docs-43). Missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on the change-walkthrough and grouping feature, explicit confirmation that summaries generate on every PR by default (the main description doc sits under an archive path), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
